lots.guide_summary: All sold, all Gowans Hobart hammer prices in AUD (no conversion, premium extra). The two close comparables, an old oak workbench with 16 drawers ($360, Sep 2026) and an 18 drawer workshop drawer bank ($475, Mar 2026), set the range. A rustic old vice bench made $420 (category guide); plain pine benches $80 to $110 are the floor. No unsold or asking entries survive.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD $360 / 1.22 = $295.08, round down to $295 hammer ($360 all-in). Flip: likely resale $360 (lowest close SOLD, used as resale at a local auction) less about 20% selling costs (seller commission about 15% plus GST and lotting fees, assumed) = $288, no outbound postage (buyer collects, too big to post), / 2.44 = $118, round down to $115 hammer. Neither close comparable is the identical item, so treat both caps as soft; the painted lettering may appeal more than either comparable, but three replacement drawers and the worn finish cut the other way.
lots.confidence_reason: Drawer labels read clearly in the photos and two close Gowans sales within 7 months were opened and their photos viewed, but neither is the same item (one is a vice bench, one an upright cabinet), so not High.
lots.condition: Heavily aged and worn paint, plank top weathered with old stains and nail holes, three bottom drawers are later white-painted replacements, one drawer runner looks loose in photo 2. Appears structurally sound in photos. Castors appear to be separate furniture dollies.
lots.key_photo_findings: 16 drawers in four rows of four; 13 painted with original-looking hand lettering, 3 bottom drawers bare white replacements (not four as the researcher said). Open slatted ends show raw timber. The unit rests on two black board dollies with red castors, which may be Armitage's moving dollies rather than part of the lot. No maker mark; value is decorative and rustic.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are the castor dollies under the unit included, or yard equipment? Overall length and depth? Do all 16 drawers run and are the drawer bottoms sound? Any borer in the top or carcase?
